country_event = {
	id = zin_mistake.4
	title = zin_mistake.4.t
	desc = zin_mistake.4.desc
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_black_isles_lights
	trigger = {
		zin_is_zol = yes
		OR = {
			check_variable = { var = zin_zol_bond_great value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = zin_zol_bond_lesser value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = zin_zol_bond_divine value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_zol_presence_lapsed }
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 540
		modifier = {
			factor = 2
			has_country_flag = zin_zol_bonds_steadfast
		}
	}
	timeout_days = 30

	option = {
		name = zin_mistake.4.a
		zin_zol_falter = yes
	}
}
